subject: Request: extension & sandbox top-up — SkyForge integration hold
messages:
From: Zoë Patel <zoe@skyforge.ai>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Integration hold — asking for trial extension/top-up

Hi Elliot,

Quick update from our side: we hit an unexpected blocker with a third-party payments connector (their new rate-limiting policy is throttling our staged calls). Our engineers are tied up validating fallbacks and we don’t have the bandwidth to finish the Redwood integration this sprint.

Given the delay, can Redwood extend our pilot window by 3 weeks and add a small sandbox credit top-up so our team can continue end-to-end verification once the connector is fixed? We currently have ~2 days of runway left for realistic load tests.

I attached a short log excerpt and the vendor support ticket.

What would you need from us to approve this? Samir (cc’d) is the technical lead if you want details.

Thanks,
Zoë Patel
Customer Success Lead
SkyForge

Attachment: integration-error-log.pdf (1 page, excerpt)
From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.ai>
To: Zoë Patel <zoe@skyforge.ai>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.khan@skyforge.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Integration hold — asking for trial extension/top-up

Zoë — thanks for flagging and for the log. Sorry to hear about the vendor throttle.

I’ve looped in Marissa (sales manager) and Hannah (CS lead) so we can triage quickly. To move this along, could you confirm:
- ETA from the vendor on the fix / their ticket number
- Which test flows are blocked (payments auth, refunds, webhooks?)
- Whether you still need streaming/throughput-level capacity once unblocked or just smoke tests

Initial idea from my side: we can typically approve a 1-week extension + a small sandbox credit bundle as a bridge while we evaluate impact. If the vendor shows the outage will be longer we’ll escalate.

I’ll get Marissa’s sign-off path and come back with a concrete proposal by EOD tomorrow.

— Elliot
Elliot Price | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
elliot.price@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Zoë Patel <zoe@skyforge.ai>, Samir Khan <samir.khan@skyforge.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Integration hold — asking for trial extension/top-up

Elliot / team — thanks for the context. I reviewed SkyForge’s usage and current pilot terms. Approve an interim offer: up to 2 weeks extension plus up to $1,000 in sandbox credits (to be applied to their pilot account) while they work through the vendor issue.

Conditions:
- We need the vendor ticket ID and a short note from SkyForge confirming the blocker is external (Zoë, can you paste the support ticket link or screenshot).
- If SkyForge requests more than 2 weeks we’ll need a brief escalation doc (what’s impacted, why internal workaround not possible, and customer timeline).

Elliot — please draft the updated terms and I’ll sign off. Hannah, please prepare CS playbook notes so we can re-run tests when they’re unblocked.

Marissa Cole
Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Zoë Patel <zoe@skyforge.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.khan@skyforge.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2026 10:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Integration hold — asking for trial extension/top-up

Thanks Marissa & Elliot — appreciate the quick review. Vendor support responded: ticket #SF-9824, they estimate a hotfix rollout in ~2.5 weeks (they cited a backlog on their infra change). That’s the earliest realistic timeline.

We’re asking for a 3-week extension because our engineers will need a couple of days post-fix to validate and then run full-volume tests. The $1k would be ideal, but we understand if Redwood wants to split the difference.

We’ll paste the vendor ticket threads into the HubSpot deal record for visibility.

— Zoë
From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.ai>
To: Zoë Patel <zoe@skyforge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2026 16:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Integration hold — asking for trial extension/top-up

Zoë — thanks for the vendor ticket and the clear ask. After discussing with Marissa and checking budget for pilot promotions, we can approve the following:

1) Extension: 3 weeks (pilot expiry moved from 2026-10-06 to 2026-10-27)
2) Sandbox credits: $750 applied to the SkyForge pilot account
3) Conditions: post-fix, SkyForge will notify Hannah to schedule a verification window; credits are for test usage only and expire 60 days after grant.

I’ve also linked the HubSpot deal so operations can apply the credit quickly: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/DEAL-4321. If the vendor timeline slips further, please flag immediately and we’ll review an additional extension.

Zoë — would you like a short note from me that you can attach to the vendor ticket or internal milestone doc?

— Elliot
Elliot Price | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
elliot.price@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachment: none
